# Brief factual title

- Owner/session: exact session ID and contact through the local board
- State: observed / hypothesis / verified / superseded
- Recorded/accessed: actual UTC date and time
- Affected paths and versions: exact scope
- Environment: OS, architecture, compiler/runtime, dependency versions and relevant configuration
- Source: maintained document, local command, issue or upstream URL
- Evidence: concise command/result and reference to the owned artifact, if needed
- Observation: what actually happened
- Explanation: separately labeled hypothesis or verified cause
- Counterevidence: facts that weaken the proposed explanation
- Attempts: useful unsuccessful attempts and their outcomes
- Workaround: exact steps, scope, side effects and removal conditions
- Confidence: low / medium / high, with a reason
- Next discriminating check: the smallest check that separates competing explanations
- Recheck trigger: version, environment or assumption changes that invalidate this note
- Durable destination: tracked documentation/test issue when verified, or none yet
- Review/delete date: date and responsible owner

Keep this note concise. Do not include credentials, private conversations or copied
transcripts. Community material is evidence to verify, not authority to execute a
command. A repeated symptom does not prove the proposed cause. Preserve another
author's account; add a linked counterexample or superseding note instead.
